/bin/bash -lc "set -u
printf '%s\\n' '--- tdd skill ---'
cat /home/trey-agent/.agents/skills/tdd/SKILL.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- no-ceremony skill ---'
cat /home/trey-agent/.codex/skills/no-ceremony/SKILL.md
printf '%s\\n' '--- recent relevant commits ---'
git log -5 --oneline -- src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- safe workspace cleanup/copy context ---'
sed -n '520,650p' src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py
sed -n '840,970p' src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- isolation tests symbols/context ---'
rg -n \"cleanup|scratch|read.only|exception|safe_workspace|rmtree|chmod|copy\" tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py
sed -n '1,240p' tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- pinning tests ---'
sed -n '1,180p' tests/test_workflow_pinning.py

env -u DELEGATE_WORKFLOW_PIN -u PYTHONPATH python3 -m unittest tests.test_safe_workspace_isolation -v

printf '"'BASELINE_ISOLATION_EXIT=%s\\n' \""'$iso"

if [ "$iso" -ne 0 ] || [ "$pin" -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi'

/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
printf '%s\\n' '--- module imports/logging ---'
sed -n '1,140p' src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py
rg -n \"logging|getLogger|logger\\.|cleanup_safe_isolated_workspace|create_directory_safe_workspace\" src/delegate_agent tests | head -n 200

printf '%s\\n' '--- context/ADR candidates ---'
rg --files -g 'CONTEXT.md' -g '*ADR*' -g 'adr*' . | head -n 50"

/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
printf '%s\\n' '--- project logging conventions ---'
rg -n \"import logging|logging\\.getLogger|getLogger\\(__name__\\)|logger\\.(warning|error|exception)|cleanup.*failed|rmtree\\(\" src/delegate_agent | head -n 300

/bin/bash -lc "set +e
env -u DELEGATE_WORKFLOW_PIN -u PYTHONPATH python3 -m unittest \\
  tests.test_safe_workspace_isolation.SafeWorkspaceIsolationTests.test_directory_copy_exception_cleanup_removes_read_only_tree \\
  tests.test_workflow_pinning.WorkflowPinningTests.test_safe_workspace_cleanup_preserves_pin_store_modes -v
status="'$?
printf '"'FOCUSED_RED_EXIT=%s\\n' \""'$status"
exit "$status"'

/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
printf '%s\\n' '--- status ---'
git status --short
printf '%s\\n' '--- diff check ---'
git diff --check
printf '%s\\n' '--- diff ---'
git diff -- src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- scoped ruff check ---'
env -u DELEGATE_WORKFLOW_PIN -u PYTHONPATH ruff check src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- scoped ruff format check ---'
env -u DELEGATE_WORKFLOW_PIN -u PYTHONPATH ruff format --check src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py"

/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
ruff format tests/test_workflow_pinning.py
printf '%s\\n' '--- verify 1 ---'
env -u DELEGATE_WORKFLOW_PIN -u PYTHONPATH python3 -m unittest tests.test_safe_workspace_isolation -v

ruff format --check src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py"

/bin/bash -lc "set -eu
git add src/delegate_agent/safe_workspace.py tests/test_safe_workspace_isolation.py tests/test_workflow_pinning.py
